values.note: The park posts tax-included rates for up to 4 people (Virginia sales tax 5.3% + local lodging tax 7%); before tax: electric & water $68.03 ($76.40 with tax), full hookup $72.42 ($81.33), 50-amp full hookup $79.01 ($88.73), waterfront $81.20 ($91.19). Holiday/event nights about $22 more (waterfront $113.60 with tax). Primitive no-hookup sites $61.62 with tax.
